what: AR53, the goals' look, for TR54: research's pick B (2026-11-23, 17:49) with its must-fix 1 and the fall's card, redrawn on the director's cut of the Mask Ledger (2026-11-23, by 18:38): the dare's mark in the kit's make, Next pinned at the Today list's head. Every word is TR54's (docs/test-requests.md, TR54: the dares, today's three, Next, the labels): this file holds where words sit, never the words.
units: points at the smallest phone (568 x 320); every box is left, top, width, height; a word's y is its capitals' top; images at 4 pixels a point, edge alpha 0. An image's `origin` is where its lay point sits in it, in points from its top left (times 4 for pixels): a lay's `origin` is where that point goes

line.note: the run's line as StageController builds it; boxes from the line's glass's top left

unfolded.held: about 3 s from the stretch's start (a seed: TR54's Config), then it folds

tab.make: the line's own glass, under it, corners cut 4

folded.broken: the mark's image swaps to DareMarkDark; no words, no sound
folded.kept: DareMarkKept once, as the stretch clears

line.hard: the same row and tab in the Hard line's glass (the ember's edge)

marks.origin: 10 right of stretch k's mark's right edge, on the road's middle, for each k kept

chip.row: last on the time's row, the row's gap (8) before it; on the fall's card a row of its own under the line that says where the next run starts, 26 tall, the chip centred, 2 down

stone.make: the kit's Common item cell with the forge stone's picture of the ground's grade (StoneLow on Lantern Row) at 0.94 and a hairline in the edge #E2CFA4 over its rim, as Reinforce draws its stone

chip.widest: with a new best the row is about 297 of the card's 320 by the sheet's letter widths: not measured in the game's face, so the first capture checks it

card.none: no dare kept: no mark, no chip, on either card

dare.note: the mark's image is 40 points square, its middle the origin: the mark itself is 16 tall and 12.8 wide

today.note: boxes from Home's glass's top left (build/handoff/UI/home_cards/home_cards.json). HomeSettings, HomeSettingsPress and the Settings label leave the panel: Settings is the cog tile

card.waits: HomeTodayWaits shows while any goal, today's or banked, waits to be claimed

shard.image: the Lantern Row shard's small picture (shard_standard_small)

pips.note: today's three in the lists' order: fight, base, roster

word.make: Home's words: bold, leaning, a soft dark under

list.note: in the glass alone: the three cards, the cog tile and the Today card hidden, HomeGlass and HomePointer kept

next.note: pinned at the list's head, never a press, never scrolling; TR54's line split at its first full stop: the step, then what it opens, wrapped; the last line stands alone
next.origin: the plate's top, its foot's left corner

lines.x: 14 + 0.2 x (the plate's height - 14 - 17 j) for line j: the plate's lean
lines.wrap: at the plate's width less 28 (314): in the sheet's face only the 55-letter line takes a third row

label.note: on line 0, the step 38 to its right

rows.origin: a row's top, its foot's left corner
rows.frame: the rows scroll between Next's foot + 4 and the glass's foot - 4, cut there
rows.done: the whole row is the claim's press

scroll.shows: 111, 94 or 77 points of rows under a Next of one, two or three lines: today's three (140) always scroll

DareMark.use: the dare's mark, lit while the dare holds

DareMarkKept.use: the dare's mark, its flare, kept

DareMarkDark.use: the dare's mark, dark and split once broken

HomeCog.use: Settings, a cog tile at the head of Settings' column

HomeCogPress.use: over the cog tile while it's held

HomeToday.use: the Today card, under the cog tile

HomeTodayWaits.use: over the Today card while a goal waits to be claimed

HomeTodayPress.use: over the Today card while it's held

GoalPipOpen.use: one of today's three on the card: open

GoalPipDone.use: one of today's three on the card: done

GoalPipClaimed.use: one of today's three on the card: claimed

GoalRowPress.use: over a done row while it's held: the row is the claim's press

GoalCheck.use: a claimed goal's check, where its shard was

GoalNext1.use: Next's plate at the list's head, for 1 line: pinned, never a press

GoalNext2.use: Next's plate at the list's head, for 2 lines: pinned, never a press

GoalNext3.use: Next's plate at the list's head, for 3 lines: pinned, never a press

motion: nothing moves here beyond what the kit does (a press, a screen opening). The unfold, the fold into the tab, the flare and the mark's split are TR54's block, and research reads them in motion there
